A projector lens (f = +10 cm) must form a real image on a screen 3 m away. Estimate how far the slide must be from the lens, and describe the image.
questions.modelAnswer: v = +300 cm, f = +10 cm. 1/u = 1/v − 1/f = 1/300 − 1/10 = −29/300, so u ≈ −10.3 cm: the slide is just beyond the focus, about 10.3 cm from the lens. m = v/u ≈ 300/−10.3 ≈ −29: a real, inverted image about 29 times larger (so slides are put in upside down).
questions.explain: Criterion D: applying the lens formula.
